reviewer.method: Bounded objective/contracts/media before implementation. Builder rationale, closure drafts and integration narrative excluded. Product implementation inspection unnecessary; frozen Git used only for workflow/reference export and application-path comparison.

decision.meaning: All three earlier findings closed for local preparation; continue exact-candidate evidence verification and ordinary protected qualification. No protected or owner acceptance granted.

reassessedFindings.observation: Fresh group evidence progresses beyond initial Desk Map/bedroom: mixed selection, proposals, group movement, individual member selection, membership restrictions, exclusions, reorder and reload are visible. The eight group cases now belong to completed browser-10 (8 passes). The old harness failure is not reclassified as an implementation defect.
reassessedFindings.nextAction: Retain original failed run/review; carry exact current candidate through protected capture/replay. No further local repair requested.

reassessedFindings.observation: Native 1440x1000 animation-end/reloaded-zoom and 1280x800/1440x1000 keyboard/pointer repair stills show all seven viewport tools above the footer. Surfaces is completely labeled/focused and activation reveals the picker. Expanded Timeline is reachable through vertical scrolling rather than squeezing the rail into a shortened canvas.
reassessedFindings.nextAction: Retain repaired desktop keyboard/pointer states in final capture. No further local repair requested.

reassessedFindings.observation: No-fit retains the no-insertion explanation and now offers Edit room layout/Dismiss. Its succeeding native state shows actual Environment editing with retained room, replacing unrelated Retry save/Review saved revision actions.

dimensions.title: Composition
dimensions.observation: The blue workspace gives the room a stable central field, content/hierarchy at left and contextual properties at right. Assistance overlays this field and the room remains consistent across floating, docked and Focus presentations. At constrained sizes side content becomes a task panel; the phone canvas and controls remain reachable.
dimensions.limits: Rendered browser composition, including intentionally scrolled states; no physical device or native layout proof.

dimensions.title: Hierarchy
dimensions.observation: Shared Environment and editing Scene are separately named above the editor. Manager distinguishes baseline creation, active Scene, impact review and comparison. Each affected Scene has its own deliberate revalidation action. Selected proposal content is labeled unapplied rather than saved.
dimensions.limits: Visible distinctions do not independently prove database authority or every lifecycle branch.

dimensions.title: Typography
dimensions.observation: Native Inspector and Manager captures have readable headings, persistent field labels and short explanations; engineering coordinates remain subordinate to item identity. Phone rights and recovery messages wrap completely. The large Assistant welcome uses space but leaves a separated composer.
dimensions.limits: Most WebMs are 800x450; typography judgments use native PNGs. No text enlargement or browser zoom evaluation.

dimensions.title: Spacing
dimensions.observation: The repaired seven-control rail ends above the footer without Clamp/Surfaces overlap. Expanded Timeline preserves canvas height and permits vertical scrolling to lower controls; the 1280x800 still reaches Timeline/keyframes. Phone controls wrap into rows.
dimensions.limits: Controls above a scrolled region are not diagnosed as clipped just because they are outside that screenshot. Arbitrary heights are untested.

dimensions.title: Controls and affordances
dimensions.observation: Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Grid/Clamp/Surfaces retain labels and state outlines. Group controls expose the selection center/rotation/scale and an individual member regains its Inspector. Mixed room/asset selections explain upright-Y/uniform-scale rules; membership explains read-only room features until Environment editing.
dimensions.limits: Supplied browser pointer/keyboard journeys only; physical touch accuracy untested.

dimensions.title: Contrast and appearance
dimensions.observation: Light mode carries the blue family through viewport, graph, Inspector, Assistant and Library. Dark mode has clear selected states and input boundaries. Native focus/error states stand out; room silhouettes stay distinguishable.
dimensions.limits: No independent numerical contrast measurement or impairment simulation; no WCAG certification.

dimensions.title: Consistency and accepted references
dimensions.observation: Accepted Homeport desktop/mobile artifacts establish visible account access, action hierarchy and contextual navigation. Studio preserves those structural principles with its contracted blue authoring family, while Player/Community retain their visual families. Library tabs, contextual Inspectors and explicit returns recur.
dimensions.limits: Reference artifacts were exported from frozen candidate. Declared historical source lacks these later saved evidence paths; no historical artifact identity equivalence asserted.

dimensions.title: Populated, empty, adverse and recovery states
dimensions.observation: Empty Library/editor, pending/cancelled proposals, invalid transforms, locked membership, unavailable selection, save errors and successful recovery are represented. No-fit now offers Edit room layout/Dismiss and leads to actual Environment editing. Photo timeout/network errors retain inputs and state that the room is unchanged.
dimensions.limits: Synthetic bounded states. Failed special-05 media remain diagnostics rather than successful successor proof.

dimensions.title: Responsive behavior
dimensions.observation: Native phone Library, properties, Environment editor and publishing retain task actions in stacked layouts. View/audio controls become a labeled disclosure at 390px. The 844x390 Assistant separates conversation/composer side by side; desktop Focus expands the room when panels close.
dimensions.limits: Chromium viewport emulation only; no iPhone Safari, physical touch, keyboard, safe-area or sensor proof.

dimensions.title: Keyboard operation
dimensions.observation: The supplied SC02 keyboard sequence enters through Creator Library, inspects/adds a chest and composition, reaches properties, saves and returns. Repaired Surfaces has a strong focus ring. Group/dialog actions and numeric transforms offer alternatives to gizmo-only manipulation.
dimensions.limits: Observed supplied media rather than replaying every key. No screen-reader run or full accessibility certification.

dimensions.title: Focus and selection recovery
dimensions.observation: Selection appears in graph, outline and named viewport badge. Missing selection provides Undo, Scene settings and a surviving-item action; F0149 proceeds to restoration/multiselection. Transparent content retains an outline/Reveal in editor. Unapplied selection provides Review placement preview.
dimensions.limits: Every focus trap, DOM order, return-focus target and assistive pairing remain unexercised.

dimensions.title: Action feedback and status
dimensions.observation: Draft/revision feedback changes after Apply/save. Assistant separates thinking/review/cancel/failure from mutation. Monthly allowance reached leaves manual editing available. Photo processing has progress/cancel. Publishing ends at Community review next, distinct from publicly approved.
dimensions.limits: Most contracts specify 3000ms browser feedback. Action-to-feedback latency was not independently measured; sampled timestamps cannot prove that budget.

dimensions.title: Motion, transitions and audio
dimensions.observation: Temporal samples show editor/Assistant entry, proposal before Apply, applied state, reload, Timeline changes, simulation reset and Guided return. Timeline explains Step as instantaneous and Linear/Ease as animated. Reduced-motion states preserve readable meaning and actions.
dimensions.limits: 60/164 WebMs inspected as 540 decoded frames, not continuous real-time playback. They span 3.52-91.52s each (954.4s source duration). Samples may miss short defects. All 164 have no audio stream; sound, smoothness, frame-rate and audio timing are unaccepted.

dimensions.title: Identity, history and return continuity
dimensions.observation: The same Scene stays behind assistance and survives review/save/reload. Independent copy/original names differ. Environment editing returns to the Scene, shared version impact is explicit, profile detours return to private saved source, and Lens closes to the same Voyage Journal.
dimensions.limits: Visible synthetic browser continuity plus reported tests; not a new persistence-internals or live-device synchronization proof.

dimensions.title: Complexity and progressive disclosure
dimensions.observation: Guided/Standard/Engineering preserve item identity while exposing different control depths (same selected letter in F0504/F0505/F0506). Effects, room/exclusion and simulation controls remain contextual. Library filters/tabs/expansion constrain collections; the 2000-Scene sample reaches individual version/copy actions.
dimensions.limits: Engineering is dense, but Focus/depth choices provide supported reduction. Density alone is not a confirmed contract failure.

dimensions.title: Role outcomes and governed sharing
dimensions.observation: Creator visibly places, inspects, saves and reuses modeled/effect content. Publishing names included objects, behavior and animation. Installed content exposes pinned release/credits/license and separates permitted private copy from original. Phone refusal blocks unresolved model redistribution. Admin policy/People flows preserve usage history wording.
dimensions.limits: special-08 18/18 is counted; special-05 15/1/2 is not. No legal clearance, production moderation, paid provider or owner acceptance granted.

dimensions.title: Capability fallbacks and truthful limits
dimensions.observation: Renderer loss retains hierarchy/Inspector and Retry; audio unavailable explains browser permission; transparent/hidden items are recoverable. Guided Lens keeps the same Captain note and Choose/Inspect/Place. Tracking failure reports confidence NONE/alignment not aligned, offers recalibrate/Guided, and labels the tracker a local prototype.
dimensions.limits: No physical tracking, metric reconstruction, native rendering, signed installation or real adventure claim. PE-DEBT-PARALLAX-PLAYER remains owned by Spatial Experience Refit.

contractJourneys.title: Creator entry, models/effects, reusable composition and Player handoff
contractJourneys.observation: Natural Creator Library entry/return appear in the keyboard sequence. Chest has modeled geometry. Composition insertion exposes editable children and save/reuse. Separate Player Journal/Lens retains a readable note and supported interactions.
contractJourneys.limits: PE-DEBT-PARALLAX-PLAYER remains. Physical/native/live-provider and owner trials unexercised.

contractJourneys.title: Inspector depths, room context and recovery
contractJourneys.observation: Selected item persists across Guided/Standard/Engineering. SC00B samples cover asset, light, audio, interaction region, mist/particle/projection/phenomenon, room feature and exclusion context. Missing selection provides recovery; edits/reload/return are represented.
contractJourneys.limits: Exhaustive SC00B detail is mostly 800x450 recording; five decoded frames separately inspected. Not every field or assistive technology certified.

contractJourneys.title: Assistant presentation and continuity
contractJourneys.observation: Floating/docked/moved/resized and low-height composer layouts preserve room and identity. Phone has scrollable conversation/stable composer. Proposal, clarification, cancel, quota and unavailable feedback are distinct.
contractJourneys.limits: No live AI quality, speech/audio or latency acceptance.

contractJourneys.title: Synthetic Environments and surface placement
contractJourneys.observation: All ten room families are distinct in the complete still survey. Desk/table/wall/floor show aligned placement. Temporal samples cover snap changes, Undo/reload and constrained picker. No-fit leads to layout correction.
contractJourneys.limits: Synthetic cutaway models only; actual room fit, collision safety, scale and surface detection require physical proof.

contractJourneys.title: Library, working identity, versions, groups and Timeline
contractJourneys.observation: Typed content, explicit Add, independent copies, version preview, history and definition/active-instance/archive distinctions are present. Groups/exclusions go beyond fixtures. Timeline has clips/keyframes/interpolation; simulation explicitly leaves Chronicle progression unchanged. The 2000-Scene sequence reaches paging/search/expanded inspection.
contractJourneys.limits: Performance/resource-cleanup receipts are not perceived-performance proof. Arbitrary collection sizes and all concurrency branches unexercised.

contractJourneys.title: Environment editing and known measurements
contractJourneys.observation: Room features have explicit Environment editing/feature selection. Support references are protected/labeled; known measurements, invalid entries, live changes and reload are represented. Phone retains editing/return actions.
contractJourneys.limits: Saved parametric measurements do not establish real reconstruction accuracy.

contractJourneys.title: Photo permission, proposal, application and recovery
contractJourneys.observation: One/two-view synthetic inputs pass permission/processing/review. Geometry is approximate and unchanged until Apply; confirmed scale takes precedence. Permission withdrawal retains authored geometry. Cancel/clarify/timeout/network paths preserve inputs/room with retry/manual paths.
contractJourneys.limits: Synthetic screenshots/stub responses only. No private photos, paid calls, model fidelity, sanitation or deletion internals independently qualified.

contractJourneys.title: Independent Scenes and shared Environment lifecycle
contractJourneys.observation: Manager separates baseline/version from working Scene, names active Scene, supports duplicate/compare and lists shared Environment impact before per-Scene revalidation. Error/recovered save stills retain Scene name; version/association are visible.
contractJourneys.limits: Not every stale/concurrent/lifecycle branch replayed by reviewer; exact-source tests/protected qualification remain separate.

contractJourneys.title: Community package, rights, profile and installation
contractJourneys.observation: Five stages show saved private source, profile prerequisite/return, included content, rights and package review. Environment/composition/effect/asset examples reach moderation-submitted. Retry recovers recorded release. Installed content exposes pinned version/credits/license and private-copy reuse. Unresolved model redistribution is refused on phone.
contractJourneys.limits: Uses successful b72 special-08 successors for counted outcomes. Synthetic moderation is not production publication, rights clearance or owner approval.
